page.layout: Top: two round medallion portraits side by side, with legends, not text. Below them one column of text in two paragraphs. Below the text: a decorative tailpiece ornament, no text. Running head at top centre; page number at top right.

main_text.p: L. OTHO, Imperatoris Othonis pater, materno genere præclaro, multarúmque & magnarum propinquitatum, tam charus,támq; non absimilis facie Tiberio principi fuit,ut plerique procreatū ex eo crederent.Hic urbanos honores,Proconsulatum Africæ,& extraordinaria imperia seuerissimè administrauit. Senatus hunc honore rarissimo,statua in palatio posita, prosecutus est: & Claudius allectum inter Patricios collaudās hunc amplissimis verbis,hæc quoq; adiecit:Vir,quo meliores libe-ros habere ne opto quidem. Sueton.in Othone.

ALBIA Terentia splendidissima fœmina,L.Othonis uxor fuit,quæ peperit illi L. Titianum,siue Terentianū,& minorem Marcum,cognominem patri,Othonémq; appellatum,qui post Galbam imperavit:peperit quoq; filiam, quam nondum nubi-lem Drufo Germanici filio despōdit, Consulito Suetonium in Othone.

page.notes: The two medallions carry engraved legends (left: L. SILVIVS OTHO ... IMP. PATER; right: ALBIA TERENTIA OTHO IMP. ...); these are illustrations, not running text, and are not transcribed. Tailpiece ornament at the foot is not text.
